beta_construction: For each seed, use its established master profile. For each N, reshape to (N, 4800/N) and take nested block means; the same profile is used at every strength.
cross_size_path_definition: For each seed and each of the 13 strengths, retain complete 2x2 cross-size matrices on all three common grids. These matrices are not same-N state tracking.
native_path_definition: For each seed, N and each of the 12 adjacent strength pairs, compare native two-dimensional subspaces after reduced QR. Finite links are not continuous-path proof.
within_seed_refinement: For each seed separately, compare the original 9-point/8-link subset with the refined 13-point/12-link path for extrema, jumps, drivers and native-link minima.
cross_seed_comparison: Compare seed=0, seed=1 and the stored seed=6 reference for extrema locations, maximum-jump links, driver patterns and native-link minima. Agreement or disagreement is descriptive, not a universality test.
entry_link_definition: For every cross-size matrix entry and adjacent strength pair, compute delta_O_ij, score contribution delta_O_ij/2 and both singular-channel contributions delta_(s_k^2)/2. Dominance is numerical only.
outcome_policy: Retain every preregistered seed, point and link; do not add or remove seeds or strengths after inspecting outcomes.
